description: Records or updates the DVLA document delivery status for a material

materialId.description: The identifier of the material this document delivery record relates to

emailStatus.description: The status of the email notification

payloadBlobUri.description: The blob storage URI of the payload

documentBlobUri.description: The blob storage URI of the document

caseId.description: The identifier of the SJP case this material relates to

sjpCorrelationId.description: The correlation identifier for the SJP case processing

sjpStatus.description: The SJP status of the material for this case (one of the DvlaDocumentDeliveryMaterialStatus values: PENDING, SUCCESS, FAILED)
